findings.location: Second paragraph, sentence beginning "Though these three men..."
findings.source_quote: The real catalyst for flaming the fires of revival was kindled 88 years earlier.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the incorrect Hindi word "शंकु" with a correct translation for "catalyst" such as "उद्दीपक कारण", "प्रेरक" or "उत्तेजक तत्व". For example: "पुनरुद्धार की आग को वास्तव में भड़काने वाला प्रेरक 88 साल पहले जला था।" Preserve surrounding sentence structure and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: पुनरुद्धार की अग्नि को वास्तव में भड़काने वाला शंकु 88 साल पहले जला था।

findings.location: Fifth paragraph, quoted Scripture and parenthetical reference
findings.source_quote: “And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh” (Ecclesiastes 12:12).
findings.suggested_fix: Localize the book name to the conventional Hindi Bible name and keep chapter and verse numbers unchanged. Change the parenthetical "(Ecclesiastes 12:12)" to "(सभोपदेशक 12:12)" or the regionally appropriate Hindi form. Ensure the quoted verse remains translated into Hindi as it already is, but update only the book name in the reference. Example fix: “...अनेक पुस्तकें बनाने का अंत नहीं है; और अधिक अध्ययन देह को श्रम का कारण है” (सभोपदेशक 12:12)।
findings.translation_quote: “और आगे, मेरे पुत्र, इनसे भी सहमनित हो: अनेक पुस्तकें बनाने का अंत नहीं है; और अधिक अध्ययन देह को श्रम का कारण है” (Ecclesiastes 12:12)。
